description: Catalog pointer for PLX company skills. Skill ids are authoritative in the skills repo manifest.json (packages[].skillIds).
notes: petralabx/skills is the canonical company skill content repo. The pin is a release tag rather than a sha: petralabx/skills tags each merge to main with v<manifest.version>, so v1.6.4 is readable, immutable, and resolves to exactly one commit. Merge this pin only after petralabx/skills#27 is merged and the release-tag workflow has created v1.6.4. v1.6.4 adds research-eval-reuse (reuse-before-custom-build gate) and fail-closed laptop sync to Grok/Hermes/.agents; v1.6.3 is the overlay-safe Cloud distribute; v1.6.2 enforced executable-mode parity. The pin is what colleagues resolve against, so a skill published to the catalog is not installable until this field moves. Provenance comes from the ref actually fetched. legacySourceRepo documents the pre-migration source.
